desc: Formalize state as (unactivated piles by parity, pass pool P); note activation flips parity of (o+P) and simplifies the game.
Derive closed form: N=1 Fennec; N=2 always Snuke; N=3 Fennec iff any odd A_i; N>=4 Fennec iff count of odd A_i is odd.
Implement O(N) solution using the closed form.

Independently confirm edge cases via hand minimax: N=2 always Snuke; N=3 all-even -> Snuke, any-odd -> Fennec; N=4 all A_i=1 (o=4 even) -> Snuke; N=4 with one odd (o=1) -> Fennec; consistent with pass-parity induction from the m=3 base.
